title: Informações gerais e texto editável da p.56
scopeLimits: This expanded proposal covers all 21 editable rule/title units in the page 56 text families: General Information, Activation Numbers and Groups, Combatant Tags, and the two bottom example paragraphs.
Printed card text, creature names on cards, diagram labels and the two Cave Sickle Group labels remain in English as source artwork, per the user decision.
The source-line count for block_10 must use its two visible text lines only; the coarse block bbox overlaps unrelated card artwork/blank source rows.
Technical copyfit and visual checks do not resolve the glossary-pending term candidates listed above.

candidates.sourceText: Across the top of most Combatant Cards players will find up to 3 different colored boxes with numbers in them. These are called Activation Numbers. Each Activation Number has a color associated with it. Each color has a corresponding colored base snap to keep track of multiple figures of the same type on the game board.
candidates.proposalText: Na parte superior da maioria das Cartas de Combatente há até 3 caixas coloridas, cada uma com um número. Esses números são chamados de Números de Ativação. Cada Número de Ativação corresponde a uma cor, associada a uma presilha colorida na base para diferenciar miniaturas do mesmo tipo no tabuleiro.

candidates.sourceText: This means that if enough Combatants Spawn, or if a Diagram calls for a specific set of figures with Activations Numbers in differing Groups, you will have multiple Initiative Cards placed at different positions on the Initiative Track. These Groups will take turns at different moments than other Groups of the same type of Combatant.

Assim, Grupos do mesmo tipo de Combatente realizam seus turnos em momentos diferentes.

candidates.sourceText: A Group's corresponding Initiative Card is only ever removed from the Initiative Track when the last figure in a Group is Defeated. Additionally, figures in a Group are considered separate figures and keep track of all Damage and Effects separately. Activation Numbers are used to keep track of which figures might have Damage tokens and Effects. When a figure in a Group Gains or loses a token, a player puts the token above the corresponding Activation Number.
candidates.proposalText: A Carta de Iniciativa correspondente só é retirada da Trilha quando a última miniatura do Grupo é Derrotada. Além disso, cada miniatura do Grupo é considerada separadamente e mantém seu próprio controle de Dano e Efeitos. Os Números de Ativação identificam quais miniaturas podem ter fichas de Dano e Efeitos. Quando uma miniatura do Grupo obtém ou perde uma ficha, o jogador a coloca acima do Número de Ativação correspondente.

candidates.sourceText: Combatant Tags are Tags that are uniquely associated with Combatant Cards. These Tags are listed in the top right hand corner of Combatant Cards and have their own special rules. Some Combatant Tags might be referenced by other cards and Abilities controlled by Adventurers or Combatants. See Combatant Tags Pg. 91.

terminologyPendingHumanReview: Group → Grupo; Initiative Track → Trilha de Iniciativa; Group Number → Número do Grupo are approved Payload decisions and are applied as written.

Combatant → Combatente has only a scoped local precedent at p.19; it is not a global mapping. Command/Intelligent Combatant, Combatant Card, Initiative Card, Activation Number, and Combatant Tag still have no canonical approved mapping in the official glossary/Payload. Keep current page forms provisional.

Figures → Miniaturas, Spawn → Surgir/Faça Surgir, Adventurers → Aventureiros, Encounter → Encontro, See → Veja, Gain → obter (inflect naturally) follow approved glossary decisions.
Cave Sickle remains the English printed creature name per user instruction; printed cards and diagram labels remain source artwork.
